class: citation outside the span its entry pins

expect.why: the note cites the entry from its preamble, while the entry rests on the note's Observation section; the sentence that states the commitment and the span that keeps it are then in different places, and an edit to either moves only one

note: K28 is the near-negative: the same citation inside the Observation section. Every other seed is a near-negative too, by construction — each has documents and grounds that name different files, which is the case this rule must never fire on, and the corpus contract fails a seed that catches anything its rows do not list. The rule is configured off by default; the corpus runs with it on, which is what makes these rows reachable at all.
